newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania Gas, Hermis Bank active as shares rise. [CORRECTED 17:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lithuania Gas, Hermis Bank active as shares rise. [CORRECTED 17:42 GMT]

text.p: The Lithuanian share market rose further on Tuesday and Lithuanian Gas and leading bank Hermis Bank were the most actively traded.
Overall central market volume came to 483,677 litas and the group A index rose 62.28 points to 1847.72. The Group A index traces the 35 most active stocks on the Lithuanian market.
Block trades worth 723,665 litas were made and the secondary market of government Treasury bills turned over 293,715 litas.
Lithuanian Gas saw its shares rise to 1.55 litas from 1.48 on turnover of 177,137 ltas.
Hermis bank remained unchanged at 200 litas on 15,000 litas turnover on the central market but it registered the biggest single business of 345,700 litas in block trading.
The price range was from 200 to 190 litas. (Corrects from "1.8 to 1.25 litas")
Birzai Milk dairy, which recently completed a GDR issue, was also active as shares worth 125,574 litas changed hands and the price went down to 8.1 litas from 8.2.
Vilnius Bank ended higher at 200 litas against 181 on low trade of 8,000 litas.
